name: Telemetry
capability: Follow CPU, memory, temperature, connection-table capacity, WAN state, interfaces, device inventory and exporter health across four pages.

name: Bandwidth & Traffic Spikes
capability: Find top traffic peers and estimated service ports, compare directions, and inspect large observed flows.

name: Inbound Access
capability: Investigate forwarded inbound attempts, destination hosts and ports; enrich source context when available.

name: LAN Devices
capability: Break down local traffic by device labels, addresses, direction and guest/IoT network; find busy or unlabelled devices.

name: Network Flow Threat Signals
capability: Explore TCP flag aggregates, SYN-only flow records and high-volume indicators, with optional peer-intelligence matches.

name: Perimeter Drop Map
capability: Inspect blocked-traffic observations, targeted ports and source networks; map origins when GeoIP is configured.

name: Router Vitals
capability: Correlate system/interface samples with router warnings, authentication-related logs and other selected system events.

name: Sources
capability: See which router source names are reporting and how their record counts change over time.

name: Threat Intel
capability: Review source and flow-peer assessments from your configured intelligence providers alongside related drops and forwarded attempts.

name: VPN Access
capability: Review forwarded VPN attempts by source address, destination, private-host classification and port.
